title: Delhi to deploy over 5,000 police personnel for Chhath Puja celebrations
description:
Security will be beefed up in Delhi for Chhath celebrations on November 15 and 16, with the deployment of more than 5,000 police personnel, police said.
Security arrangements will be particularly strengthened around the Yamuna ghats, ponds, and locations where large gatherings are expected.
Special attention will be given to areas in the East, Northeast, and Shahdara districts, where a large number of devotees are expected to assemble to perform religious rituals.
All district deputy commissioners of police have held meetings with Chhath Puja organisers and members of local committees to discuss security arrangements and crowd management, a senior officer said.
Patrols will be carried out on foot, in PCR cars, and on motorbikes across the national capital.
Special emphasis will be laid on maintaining law and order during the evening prayers on November 15 and the morning rituals on November 16, when a large number of devotees are expected to visit the ghats.
